name: Light reading
description: An open book traced by a light synthesizer: the trail is mirrored across the gutter, and every seed along it has expanded outward in chunky cells through amber, orange-red, violet and a fading blue, so the outline glows in rainbow ripples round clear pages and amber lines of text.
choices: The light synth’s mirrored, expanding seeds draw the book itself: the trail is the outline, the ripples its glow
Mirror symmetry about the gutter replaces the four-fold mandala, and there is no black screen or tile
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
